desc:
Welcome to Forsaken Roleplay!

Roleplay as a killer or survivor! 🧑‍🦲
Earn badges for extra content! 🏆
Have fun roleplaying! 💖

Press G on PC to emote, and double click the emote slot to change to your desired emote!
Update logs are available in game!

If you would wish to have your assets/images, etc removed, contact us via our community server.

We draw inspiration from the game Forsaken, but all in-game assets are entirely original and/or fully reanimated (most of them are provided by the dev team via the toolbox).

Credits: Forsaken Dev Team, Alexisfunny, realC00lb0t, ballsnecrosis
